'''Bennova''' was a businessman during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] "gifted" a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Treetor]], a hired thug of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], as a payoff. After Treetor left the employ of Jabba, Bennova hired some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to steal it back.<ref name="RPG2" />
